summary: Enhance your skills with our Service Delivery Surveys Course. Learn implementation techniques to gather valuable insights for effective service improvement.
lede: Service delivery survey design helps teams turn user feedback into evidence for improving services. Designed for service quality, customer experience, and operations professionals, it covers selecting service measures, writing unbiased questions, planning samples, and assessing response reliability; learners also build survey logic and dashboards to track service trends.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for measuring service quality, managing user experiences, or reporting on organizational performance metrics.
audience: Patient Experience Coordinators in healthcare clinical service
Citizen Engagement Specialists in local or regional
Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) Officers in non-profit
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of their organization's service delivery model and user touchpoints. No prior statistical or coding knowledge is required, though familiarity with Microsoft Excel for basic data entry is recommended. Professionals should bring a sample of a current or past survey used by their organization for the audit exercises.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
